sentences.en: Hi Mum,
sentences.zh: 妈妈你好，

sentences.en: It’s Day Two and I’m already in love with New York.
sentences.zh: 这是第二天，我已经爱上纽约了。

sentences.en: It’s amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: The first day, we were pretty tired from the flight, but we did a bit of sightseeing in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 第一天，我们因为坐飞机很累，但下午还是去观光了一下。

sentences.en: We went to see the Statue of Liberty and I wasn’t disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我们去看了自由女神像，我一点也没有失望。

sentences.en: We had a guided tour and learned all about its history.
sentences.zh: 我们参加了有导游的讲解，了解了它的全部历史。

sentences.en: It really is a powerful symbol of peace.
sentences.zh: 它真的是和平的有力象征。

sentences.en: Today, we’re going to explore Central Park and Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要去探索中央公园和曼哈顿。

sentences.en: In the evening, we’re going to watch the New York Jets.
sentences.zh: 晚上，我们要去看纽约喷气机队的比赛。

sentences.en: They’re playing at MetLife Stadium.
sentences.zh: 他们会在 MetLife 体育场比赛。

sentences.en: It’s my first game of American football and I’m looking forward to it.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次看美式橄榄球比赛，我很期待。

sentences.en: (I think – I’m quite nervous!)
sentences.zh: （我觉得——我有点紧张！）

sentences.en: The big concert we’re playing in is tomorrow and we’re all getting quite excited.
sentences.zh: 我们参加的大型音乐会就在明天，大家都很兴奋。

sentences.en: Just imagine, I’m going to play my trombone in Carnegie Hall, probably the most famous concert hall in the US.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，我要在卡内基音乐厅吹长号，那可能是美国最有名的音乐厅。

sentences.en: Mr Davis is even more excited.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯老师更加兴奋。

sentences.en: He’s going to conduct us in the concert.
sentences.zh: 他将在这场音乐会上指挥我们。

sentences.en: He keeps telling us it’s his dream come true.
sentences.zh: 他一直告诉我们，这是他梦想成真。

sentences.en: His wife’s going to record the performance.
sentences.zh: 他妻子会把演出录下来。

sentences.en: She’s going to send us all the link so you can see the greatest moment of my musical career so far!
sentences.zh: 她会把链接发给我们所有人，这样你就能看到我音乐生涯至今最了不起的时刻！

sentences.en: There are going to be bands from all over the world, from about 20 different countries.
sentences.zh: 到时会有来自世界各地大约 20 个不同国家的乐队。

sentences.en: I can’t wait!
sentences.zh: 我已经等不及了！

sentences.en: Hope you’re well and not missing me too much!
sentences.zh: 希望你一切都好，不要太想我！

sentences.en: Love, Ryan
sentences.zh: 爱你的瑞安

sentences.en: Hi Abigail,
sentences.zh: 阿比盖尔你好，

sentences.en: Sorry I didn’t write yesterday, but it was such a busy day I just didn’t get the time.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我昨天没写信，因为那天实在太忙了，我一点时间都没有。

sentences.en: We played our second volleyball match of the trip.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了这次出行的第二场排球比赛。

sentences.en: It was against the under-15 Beijing champions and they won easily.
sentences.zh: 对手是北京 U15 冠军队，他们轻松获胜。

sentences.en: I also hurt my hand quite badly.
sentences.zh: 我的手也伤得比较厉害。

sentences.en: The sports centre where we played was fantastic.
sentences.zh: 我们比赛的那家体育中心很棒。

sentences.en: Really modern and much better than ours back home.
sentences.zh: 很现代，比我们国内的好多了。

sentences.en: Anyway, I’ve got ten minutes to write to you quickly, then I’m going to the bus station to catch a bus to Luanping.
sentences.zh: 总之，我只有十分钟可以快速给你写几句，然后我要去汽车站，坐车去滦平。

sentences.en: I’m so excited because we’re going to visit the Great Wall.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋，因为我们要去看长城。

sentences.en: It was probably the one thing I wanted to do most on this trip, after playing volleyball, of course!
sentences.zh: 这可能是这次出行里我最想做的事，当然排球比赛之外。

sentences.en: We’re going to explore the Jinshanling section of the wall.
sentences.zh: 我们要去探索金山岭段的长城。

sentences.en: It’s in the mountains and it’s quite a walk to get up to it.
sentences.zh: 它在山里，要走上很长一段路才能到达。

sentences.en: But the views are spectacular.
sentences.zh: 但风景非常壮观。

sentences.en: I’m going to take loads of photos.
sentences.zh: 我会拍很多照片。

sentences.en: Luanping is about 130 km away, so we’re going to spend the night there.
sentences.zh: 滦平大约在 130 公里外，所以我们打算在那里过夜。

sentences.en: Then we’re going back to Beijing for our last day in the city.
sentences.zh: 然后我们回北京，度过在这座城市的最后一天。

sentences.en: Our last match is in the afternoon, but I’m not going to play because of my hand.
sentences.zh: 最后一场比赛在下午，但因为手受伤，我不会上场。

sentences.en: I can’t believe the trip is almost over.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信这次出行马上就要结束了。

sentences.en: China is amazing and the Chinese people are so friendly.
sentences.zh: 中国很棒，中国人也很友好。

sentences.en: I want to stay longer.
sentences.zh: 我想再多待一段时间。

sentences.en: Lots of love, Bettina
sentences.zh: 非常爱你的贝蒂娜
